decisions: Part 61-batch3: further MalawiLII acts whose current expression, and every earlier expression MalawiLII lists, could be read with its text, whose newest page lists no amendment MalawiLII has not yet applied, and whose current expression is the 2017 consolidation (Fifth Revised Edition) or later.
Left out of part 61-batch3: the Older Persons Act, 2024 (MalawiLII marks it "Not commenced") and the Referendum Act, 2018 (MalawiLII gives its commencement date as unknown).
ai_use: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5, claude-opus-5-5) wrote the configuration and the Malawi-specific scripts, and chose the acts. No model wrote, summarised or transformed legal text: parse.py is deterministic code.
